reviewed_by: Codex focused review for draft Chromium Browser Research work
reason: The PR adds an operator Chromium panel and runtime staging; this increment also launches the framed identity offscreen and adds a loopback-only chain from the Core scope proxy to the existing capture proxy. The 34 selected Python tests cover operator/API separation, runtime staging, offscreen launch, proxy authentication, scope revocation, HTTP/CONNECT chaining, and credential isolation. The prior 24 component and ten permanent desktop/mobile Playwright selections remain because they cover the full PR diff. The production real-Core/browserd smoke is a separate focused gate and now proves actual Chromium traffic traverses the Core scope proxy and local capture listener at a LAN UI origin.
exclusions: No Rust or frontend source changed in this increment, so no new Rust or UI selection is added. Unrelated Core/UI/Playwright journeys and all full suites remain excluded. The new proxy-chain tests use a bounded fake capture listener; they do not prove the Tauri capture bridge, HTTP/2/WebSocket parity, or physical Mac behavior. Browser Research integration remains incomplete, so this draft PR must not merge on the basis of these tests.
